messages:
Sophie (PartnerOps): Heads-up — customer X (marketplace + HW integrator + SI) hit a sev yesterday. We need a cleaner playbook for simultaneous partner escalations.
Chris (Eng): Agreed. The messy bit was duplicate bridges and unclear ownership.
Devon (Sales): Customer asked for a single view for SLAs and contact points — they were routed to three different queues.
Yochan (Support): Proposal: single shared channel per-customer + a named war-room when sev declared. Channel gets pinned runbook and current incident PD.
Amelia (PM): +1. Can we define a minimal handshake: who opens the war room, who adds partners, and what signals move it to "joint response" state?
Sophie (PartnerOps): Suggestion: "shared-cust-<cust>-ops" created by PartnerOps on first integration. On sev, the oncall that owns the alert creates a temporary war-room channel: "cust-<cust>-sev-YYYYMMDD" and adds partner reps.
Chris (Eng): For clarity let's codify the steps. Draft: 1) Create war room (private channel) 2) Add partner leads + PD oncall 3) Post incident TL;DR, impact, next 60m actions 4) Assign clear owner for customer comms.
Devon (Sales): Important: Sales must be tagged and given read-only summary cadence — they don't need all logs. Suggest a short "customer_comms" thread pinned.
Yochan (Support): Adding automation: partner-bot can create the war room with a cmd: `/partner-warroom create <cust> sev <sev-id>` which auto-invites known partner contacts and posts the runbook link.
partner-bot: Created channel cust-X-sev-2026-03-20 and invited: Sophie, Chris, Amelia, Devon, Yochan, @acme-hw-ops, @integrator-oncall
Sophie (PartnerOps): Runbook snippet to pin (we should store canonical link in PartnerOps space):
```
- Declare war room owner within 5m
- Post impact statement and ETA for first update (15m)
- Tag: @partner-lead, @si-oncall, @redwood-prod-oncall
- Post link to relevant dashboard and recent deploys
- Agree on who speaks to customer and CSR message cadence
```
Chris (Eng): Ops note: if hardware partner is required onsite, include an explicit "Field coord" role in the war room and list the phone number for the field lead.
Amelia (PM): Also need an SLA routing map: if latency < 200ms issue -> Eng; HW failure -> hardware partner; integration auth -> SI. Can we make a 1-pager matrix and pin it?
Devon (Sales): I'll own the 1-pager and coordinate with partners to get their contact trees.
Yochan (Support): For PD integration: when PD goes to P2/P1, PD should trigger the war room creation automatically and notify PartnerOps. Need an API hook from PD -> partner-bot.
Sophie (PartnerOps): Action items: Devon to collect partner contact lists by EOW, Chris to draft automation commands for partner-bot, Amelia to create the routing matrix, Yochan to scope PD hook. I'll compile into PartnerOps repo and share link.
Chris (Eng): Quick Q: who owns the final close confirmation to partners? I propose the war-room owner + PartnerOps sign-off.
Sophie (PartnerOps): Agreed. Close checklist should include postmortem ownership, next steps, and confirmation email template to partners.
Devon (Sales): FYI to partners: we should offer a short joint postmortem call within 48-72h. That was missing last time.
partner-bot: Reminder set: Draft joint PM notes template due in 5 days.
Amelia (PM): Looks good. If no objections I'll drop the draft playbook in this channel by EOD tomorrow for a quick review.
Chris (Eng): No objections from me.
Yochan (Support): 👍
Sophie (PartnerOps): Thanks team — this should reduce noise and speed up partner comms. I'll follow up with the PartnerOps repo link when the doc is posted.
